instruction.name: vreplgr2vr.w
instruction.description: Broadcast the low 32 bits of `val` to all lanes of `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move
experiments.notes: Round trip 5.05 cycles. vpickve2gr.w is 4 cycles, so vreplgr2vr.w is 1.05 cycles.

latencies.notes: Round trip 5.05 cycles. vpickve2gr.w is 4 cycles, so vreplgr2vr.w is 1.05 cycles. Nominal values: round-trip core cycles rounded to the nearest integer.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r5; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr3, $r7; vreplgr2vr.w $vr4, $r8; vreplgr2vr.w $vr5, $r9; vreplgr2vr.w $vr6, $r10; vreplgr2vr.w $vr7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r5; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr3, $r7; vreplgr2vr.w $vr4, $r8; vreplgr2vr.w $vr5, $r9; vreplgr2vr.w $vr6, $r10; vreplgr2vr.w $vr7, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.53 cycles. Counter 0xfb is normalised per instruction. Measured CPI 1.0662; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 1. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LSX two-uop instruction. Throughput measured with 8 independent lanes; latency measured through a vpickve2gr round trip.
